newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli soldier killed, three wounded, in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli soldier killed, three wounded, in Lebanon.

text.p: One Israeli soldier was killed and three others wounded when Hizbollah guerrillas attacked their patrol in south Lebanon on Wednesday, pro-Israeli militia sources said.

The guerrillas fired rockets, rocket-propelled grenades and machineguns at the Israeli patrol in Arnoun area on the edge of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, the South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia sources said.
"One Israeli soldier was killed and three wounded, two of them seriously, as a result of the assault," one SLA source said. "The wounded soldiers were taken by helicopter to Israel."
Wednesday's casualties raised to six Israeli soldiers killed and 26 wounded in south Lebanon this year. Last year, 27 Israeli soldiers were killed in Lebanon.
Lebanon's pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) claimed responsibility for the attack.

In Beirut, A Hizbollah spokesman told Reuters the guerrillas fired at an Israeli patrol in the Arnoun-Zafateh area just inside the Israeli-held border strip, hitting a military vehicle and killing or wounding those inside.
The guerrillas also fired mortar bombs at an Israeli post at Dabsheh and another fortified outpost held by its SLA militia allies at Ali Taher, but no one was hurt, the SLA sources added.
Israeli artillery gunners retaliated by shelling guerrilla-held areas facing Arnoun, the SLA sources said. There was no immediate report on casualties in the retaliatory bombardment.

Hizbollah is leading a guerrilla war to oust some 1,000 Israeli troops and 3,000 SLA militiamen from the 15-km (nine-miles)- deep zone in south Lebanon set up by Israel to stop cross-frontier guerrilla raids on northern Israel.
